known_limitations: S-money scenario is an event-timing/causality model only: token validity is a symbolic input; no quantum security (S1/S2 epsilon) is computed or implied here
protocol_id for S-money traces uses 's_money_kent_2022_ideal_2site' as the closest registered id; Jiang 2024 practical S-tokens are not a registered protocol (see interfaces_changed)
classical_race_fixtures.py are TEST FIXTURES, not lane H baselines; zero processing delays; must be replaced by lane H state machines and deleted at integration
Flat local frame for paper/synthetic cases; spherical-Earth chord for RIPE; no GR/Sagnac corrections
RTT/2 one-way assumption (asymmetric routing not resolved); 1 hour window, 3 probes -- not a representative Internet latency distribution
Clock error bound for RIPE sites (1 us) is a declared assumption, not measured
Engine time is float ns; comparisons use 1e-6 ns tolerance
Figure 6 plotting not implemented; data available via run_s_money + run_h0/h1/h3 on the same TopologyCase
interfaces_changed: NEW shared actor interface (qmint/networks/events.py): Actor.on_message(msg, now_ns)->list[Effect], Actor.on_local_request(LocalRequest, now_ns)->list[Effect]; Effects = Send(dst,payload,after_ns) | Record(kind,detail,after_ns) | SetTimer(delay_ns,payload); now_ns is the site's LOCAL clock reading. Lane H adapters should target this.
